title: How Wispr Flow hired 2 engineers with Contrario after testing 50+ recruiting channels
summary: Wispr Flow turns speech into polished writing in every app a person uses. The team had written off remote engineering hires after the wrong ones didn't work out, which became a problem the moment the iOS roadmap called for two more.
body_markdown: Wispr Flow turns speech into finished writing inside any application, running on foundation models it trains itself. Founded in 2021 by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg, the company has raised $81M, most recently in a round led by Notable Capital.
